name: meeting-notes-summarization
description: Turn a plain-text meeting transcript, standup log, or retro notes into a markdown NOTES.md with attendees, decisions, action items table (Owner, Due), and open questions.
spec: Skill that converts a meeting transcript into NOTES.md. Judgment-only; no bundled scripts, so no tests. Rules follow accepted sessions and the user's edit note: action items in a table with Owner and Due columns; open questions in a separate section at the end.

decision.note: approved by the user in chat
